patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content and contained content, often employing a two-column split with an image on one side and text on the other, or a grid of cards.

Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for primary section titles, often left-aligned, while body text is a clean, readable sans-serif. Smaller, uppercase labels are frequently used for categories or sub-headings.

A warm and inviting palette is used, featuring a dominant light cream/beige background (#fef7ec) contrasted with crisp white sections, black/dark grey text, and soft orange/peach (#da532c) and light blue (#5bbad5) accents for interactive elements and highlights.

The header transforms on scroll: an initial promotional banner disappears, and the main navigation bar shrinks slightly, gains a solid white background, and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport. The hero section features content scrolling over a large, relatively static background image, creating a parallax-like effect.

Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections visually separated by alternating background colors (light cream, white, and black for the footer), each typically introduced by a prominent, bold heading.

technique_notes: A responsive header system initially displays a promotional banner and a transparent navigation bar over the hero. Upon scrolling, the banner is hidden, and the main navigation bar transitions to a smaller, fixed-position element with a solid white background, ensuring persistent access.

The hero section utilizes a large, high-quality photographic background that remains largely static or exhibits a subtle parallax effect as the page content scrolls over it, creating a sense of depth and focus on the imagery.

Content is structured into clearly defined, full-width sections, often using alternating light background colors (cream and white) for visual separation. Within these sections, content is typically centered or arranged in a two-column grid, frequently featuring image-text pairings or card-based displays for services and testimonials.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body size) with a clean, readable sans-serif body text. Uppercase labels are used for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (~4-8px) on cards, buttons, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with a notably airy hero section and comfortable padding around content blocks, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site distinguishes itself with a warm, inviting, and professional aesthetic, achieved through a soft, health-conscious color palette and high-quality, authentic photography of diverse individuals. This creates a distinctive sense of approachability and trust, moving beyond typical clinical or overly corporate health branding.
